capabilities: Render HTML character entities in Live Preview
Reveal entity source when the cursor enters it
Leave inline code, code blocks, and escaped entities as source
disambiguation: It does not convert or rewrite entities in the file; it only changes how they display in Live Preview.
extras: Documents limitations: search and copy match the source text, not the rendered character.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview shows raw entity text like © as written instead of the character it represents.
summary: Renders HTML character entities as their characters in Live Preview while keeping the Markdown source untouched.
